name: Add Export/Import and Stats to TaskStore
description: TaskStore needs export/import and stats functionality
prompt: Extend src/TaskStore.js with: 1) An export() method that serializes all tasks to JSON with a version number, 2) An import() method that deserializes tasks from JSON and validates the version, 3) A getStats() method that returns counts by status (pending, completed, in-progress). Handle edge cases like version mismatch and empty data.
acceptance: export() produces valid JSON with version
